entry.name: dateFormat
entry.label: The date's format, in Qt's date format syntax (ddd: abbreviated weekday, d: day, MMM: abbreviated month, yy: year...); empty, the region's short date. The settings page offers common ones.

entry.name: timeFormat
entry.label: The time's format: 0 as the locale has it, 1 12-hour, 2 24-hour.
